description: This file initializes the React application by rendering the main App component into the DOM element with id 'root'. It imports React, ReactDOM, a CSS file, and the App component, then creates a root rendering context and renders the App within React.StrictMode.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a root DOM node for rendering a React component tree.

methods.name: root.render
methods.description: Renders a React element into the root DOM node.
